library InfernoDTRSampleCQLLibrary version '0.0.000'

include hl7.fhir.uv.cql.FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

context Patient

define "Encounters":
  [Encounter] E
    sort by start of period desc

define "LatestEncounter":
  "Encounters"[0]

define "LatestEncounterPresent":
  exists ( "Encounters" )

define "LatestLocationStatus":
  "LatestEncounter".status.value

define "LatestLocationLocationDisplay":
  "LatestEncounter".location[0].location.display.value

define function GetMiddleInitials(name FHIR.HumanName):
  Substring(Combine((name.given given
          return Substring(given.value, 0, 1)
      ), '. '
    ), 3
  )

// Grab patient FHIR HumanName


define "NameInstance":
  Coalesce(First(Patient.name name
        where name.use.value = 'official'
    ), First(Patient.name)
  )

// Extract useful name elements


define LastName:
  "NameInstance".family.value

define MiddleInitials:
  GetMiddleInitials("NameInstance")

define FirstName:
  "NameInstance".given[0].value

define InInitialPopulation:
  true

define InDenominator:
  true

define InNumerator:
  true
